title: AAPS Client CGM button missing
symptom: The CGM button is missing in AAPS Client version 3.1.0.3 dev.-g. The user reports that there is no option to select XDrip, which is available in AAPS Full Release.
cause: AAPS Client has only Nightscout as BG source, so the CGM options (like XDrip) are not present. It is by design.
fix: No fix; it is by design. The CGM button only works for xDrip and BYODA and must be enabled in preferences, but AAPS Client does not support these options.
evidence_quote: aapsclient has only NS as BG source thus these options are not there. It's by design
